Official real-time data API for the Unrivaled professional women's 3x3 basketball league, operated by Sportradar as the league's Official Data Provider. Feeds cover schedules, standings, rosters, real-time scores, play-by-play, injuries, transfers, and season statistics, in JSON or XML.
